description: 非 CI 评估用例：验证 review step 使用 InfraGuard 审查 ROS 模板；初始扫描干净时直接完成，发生修复时通过 ros_validate_template 和最终扫描后输出 template 结论。

policy_update.note: The command started a git clone from github.com/aliyun/infraguard and was interrupted after the clone stalled for more than 9 minutes in this local network. The bundled policy catalog was still available via policy list.

scan_observations.name: insecure-public-ecs
scan_observations.command: infraguard scan {fixture} --format json --mode static --policy pack:aliyun:security --policy pack:aliyun:operations --policy pack:aliyun:high-availability --no-waivers

first_violation.reason: ECS instance has a public IP bound
first_violation.recommendation: Use NAT Gateway or SLB for internet access instead of direct public IP binding

scan_observations.name: repaired-private-ecs
scan_observations.command: infraguard scan {fixture} --format json --mode static --policy pack:aliyun:security --policy pack:aliyun:operations --policy pack:aliyun:high-availability --no-waivers
scan_observations.json_shape: schema_version=2.0 with results[].violations=null for clean files

validate_template.note: All checked credential environment variables were unset; no credential values were read or printed.

evals.name: public-ecs-high-finding-is-fixed-in-place
evals.prompt: 审查上一步生成的 ROS 模板。模板创建一台 ECS，ECSGroup 设置 AllocatePublicIP: true，SecurityGroupIngress 对 0.0.0.0/0 开放 22 端口。

candidate_context.name: 低成本单机 ECS 方案
candidate_context.topology: 单可用区 VPC 内 ECS
tradeoffs: 不承诺多可用区高可用

template_context.description: VPC + VSwitch + SecurityGroup + ECS InstanceGroup，ECS 直接绑定公网 IP。

evals.expected_behavior: 先读取同一个 file_path，使用 step config 调用 infraguard_scan，发现 high/blocking finding 后只针对 InfraGuard 返回的 finding 修复原模板文件；修复后调用 ros_validate_template 校验同一个 template_url；ros_validate_template 成功后再次调用 infraguard_scan，最终 blocking_findings=0 才 complete_step。
expected_tool_sequence: select configured aspect keys from intent + candidate + template
infraguard_scan(final, same selected_aspects, after ros_validate_template, same template.file_path)

assertions.name: selects_aspects_from_context
assertions.check: 根据 intent、candidate 和模板资源选择 step_config.infraguard.aspects 中存在的 aspect key

assertions.name: records_aspect_decisions
assertions.check: complete_step.conclusion 包含 selected_review_aspects、skipped_review_aspects 和 resolved_infraguard_policies

assertions.name: uses_aspect_policy_map
assertions.check: infraguard_scan 使用 selected_aspects 和 aspect_policy_map 展开 policies，不让模型手写或编造 policy id

assertions.name: fixes_reported_public_ip_finding
assertions.check: 修复 InfraGuard 返回的 ecs-instance-no-public-ip finding；不要因为硬编码安全规则额外改写未被 finding 或校验错误覆盖的内容

assertions.name: same_file_path
assertions.check: 所有 read/write/ros_validate_template/final scan 都使用输入的 template.file_path

assertions.name: validates_after_edit
assertions.check: 模板写回后调用 ros_validate_template，参数使用 template_url=file_path，不把大模板内容塞进工具参数

assertions.name: final_scan_after_validation
assertions.check: 最终 infraguard_scan 发生在 ros_validate_template 成功之后

assertions.name: final_scan_blocks_completion
assertions.check: final infraguard_scan 返回 passed=true 且 blocking_findings=0 后才能 complete_step

assertions.name: conclusion_template_matches_file
assertions.check: complete_step.conclusion.template 与最终文件内容一致

assertions.name: no_policy_update_inside_skill
assertions.check: review skill 不调用 infraguard policy update，策略更新只属于 pipeline prerequisites

evals.name: clean-template-skips-validate-and-rescan
evals.prompt: 审查上一步生成的 ROS 模板。模板只创建 VPC、VSwitch、SecurityGroup 和一台无公网 IP 的 ECS，SSH 入口只允许 10.0.0.0/8。

candidate_context.name: 私网 ECS 低成本方案

template_context.description: 初始 InfraGuard 扫描无 high finding 的私网 ECS 模板。

evals.expected_behavior: 初始 InfraGuard 扫描无 blocking finding 且没有需要修复的 finding 时，不应修改模板，不应调用 ros_validate_template，也不应再次执行最终 infraguard_scan；应直接使用初始扫描返回的 file_content、file_sha256、expanded_policies 完成。

assertions.name: skips_unneeded_aspects_with_reason
assertions.check: 低成本单机方案应跳过 high_availability 和 elasticity，并在 skipped_review_aspects 说明原因

assertions.name: does_not_make_unneeded_edits
assertions.check: 无 finding 时不做无关模板改写

assertions.name: skips_validate_template_when_unchanged
assertions.check: 初始扫描通过且模板未修改时，不调用 ros_validate_template

assertions.name: skips_final_rescan_when_unchanged
assertions.check: 初始扫描通过且模板未修改时，不第二次调用 infraguard_scan

assertions.name: empty_review_issues
assertions.check: 如果没有发现和修复的问题，review_issues 为空数组

assertions.name: fix_summary_says_no_fix_needed
assertions.check: fix_summary 说明初始 InfraGuard 扫描通过且无需修复

evals.name: validate-template-failure-repair-loop
evals.prompt: 审查模板。InfraGuard 扫描返回需要修复的 finding；修复后 ros_validate_template 返回错误：ImageId 引用了不存在的参数 NonExistentParam，或 VSwitch 缺少必填 CidrBlock。

template_context.description: InfraGuard 修复后触发 ROS schema 校验失败的模板。
template_context.validation_error: Template format error: unresolved Ref NonExistentParam; Resource VSwitch property CidrBlock is required.

evals.expected_behavior: 只要本步骤修改过模板，就必须调用 ros_validate_template；ros_validate_template 失败时，必须根据错误修复同一个模板文件，必要时调用 aliyun_doc_search 查询 schema，重新 ros_validate_template，成功后再做最终 infraguard_scan。

assertions.name: validate_template_is_gate
assertions.check: ros_validate_template 失败时不得 complete_step

assertions.name: uses_schema_lookup_when_needed
assertions.check: 对资源属性不确定时调用 aliyun_doc_search

assertions.name: edits_same_file
assertions.check: 修复 NonExistentParam/CidrBlock 等错误时写回同一个 template.file_path

assertions.name: revalidates_after_fix
assertions.check: 每次模板修复后重新调用 ros_validate_template

assertions.name: final_scan_after_successful_validation
assertions.check: 只有 ros_validate_template 成功后才执行最终 infraguard_scan

evals.name: infraguard-v010-json-normalization
evals.prompt: review step 调用 infraguard_scan 时，底层 InfraGuard 0.10.x 返回 schema_version=2.0，findings 位于 results[].violations[]；无问题文件返回 results[].violations=null。
evals.expected_behavior: infraguard_scan 工具必须把 results[].violations[] 归一化为 findings 数组，并按 violation.severity 计算 blocking_findings；对于 violations=null 的干净文件，findings 应为空数组。

assertions.name: expands_selected_aspects
assertions.check: 工具根据 selected_aspects 和 aspect_policy_map 展开 expanded_policies，并用这些 policies 调用 InfraGuard

assertions.name: flattens_nested_violations
assertions.check: 高危 violation rule:aliyun:ecs-instance-no-public-ip 被暴露为 findings[0]

assertions.name: counts_nested_severity
assertions.check: blocking_severities=[high] 时 blocking_findings=1 且 passed=false

assertions.name: ignores_empty_violation_group
assertions.check: violations=null 时 findings=[]、blocking_findings=0、passed=true

assertions.name: keeps_repair_context
assertions.check: 归一化后的 finding 保留 resource_id、violation_path、reason、recommendation、file/line/snippet 等修复上下文

evals.name: tool-error-or-policy-missing-does-not-complete
evals.prompt: 审查模板时 infraguard_scan 返回 command_not_found、timeout、malformed_json、unexpected_exit_code，或策略 ID 不可用导致扫描失败。
evals.expected_behavior: review step 必须把扫描失败视为步骤失败或可恢复前置条件问题，不能伪造 review_passed=true，也不能在缺少必要 InfraGuard 扫描结果时 complete_step。

assertions.name: no_complete_on_scan_error
assertions.check: infraguard_scan is_error=true 时不得调用 complete_step

assertions.name: reports_actionable_error
assertions.check: 向 pipeline/session 记录 InfraGuard 命令、错误类型和 stderr 摘要，便于 prerequisite 或用户处理

assertions.name: does_not_run_policy_update
assertions.check: 即使策略缺失，skill 内也不运行 infraguard policy update；应由 prerequisites 负责

assertions.name: does_not_claim_validated
assertions.check: 扫描失败时不得输出 validated=true 或 review_passed=true 的 conclusion

evals.name: max-fix-rounds-prevents-fake-pass
evals.prompt: 审查模板时，每轮修复后 InfraGuard 仍返回 high finding，或 ros_validate_template 仍失败，直到达到 step config 的 max_fix_rounds=5。
evals.expected_behavior: 达到 max_fix_rounds 后必须停止并如实失败，不得调用 complete_step 输出通过结论；不得 rollback 到 template_generating 来规避 review 责任。

assertions.name: honors_max_fix_rounds
assertions.check: 修复轮数不超过 step_config.infraguard.max_fix_rounds

assertions.name: no_fake_review_passed
assertions.check: 修改过模板但未通过 ros_validate_template 或最终 scan 时不输出 review_passed=true

assertions.name: no_fake_validated
assertions.check: ros_validate_template 未成功时不输出 validated=true

assertions.name: no_default_rollback
assertions.check: 不默认 rollback_request 到 template_generating

assertions.name: records_remaining_issues
assertions.check: 失败结果记录剩余 findings 或 ros_validate_template 错误

evals.name: nonblocking-findings-are-recorded-not-blocking
evals.prompt: 审查模板时 InfraGuard 扫描没有 high/blocking finding，但仍存在 medium 或 low finding，blocking_severities 只配置为 [high]。
evals.expected_behavior: 可以在 blocking_findings=0 后完成，但必须在 review_issues 或 infraguard_summary 中记录非阻塞 finding；若修复简单且低风险，可以一并修复，修复后必须再验证和最终扫描。

assertions.name: uses_configured_blocking_severities
assertions.check: 只按 step config 的 blocking_severities 判定是否阻塞完成

assertions.name: records_nonblocking_findings
assertions.check: medium/low finding 不被丢弃，出现在 review_issues 或 infraguard_summary 中

assertions.name: validate_template_required_after_edit
assertions.check: 如果为非阻塞 finding 修改了模板，仍需 ros_validate_template 成功

assertions.name: final_scan_required_after_edit
assertions.check: 如果为非阻塞 finding 修改了模板，complete_step 前仍需最终 infraguard_scan
